feeds.title: Anticancer Lifestyle Program Blog
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on lifestyle transformation program for people diagnosed with cancer. Also covers articles on Diet, Fitness, Mindset, and Environment. The Anticancer Lifestyle Program (ACLP) is a comprehensive online lifestyle transformation course for cancer survivors and those who seek to reduce their risk of cancer and other chronic illnesses.

feeds.title: Admac Oncology Blog
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on cancer drugs updates, oncology products and more. Admac aims at providing innovative World-Standard medicines for all, at affordable prices.

feeds.title: Anticancer Living
feeds.description: Anticancer living is built on a belief that self-care is health care and that greater wellness is available to us all. Covers topics such as Diet, Fitness, Environment and more.
